scope: Explicit experimental native EPS source-to-DecodedRaster path
pipeline: Borrowed source framing, outer DSC bounds, density/dimension preflight, budgeted lexical compilation, native VM/vector evaluation, native fill/stroke RGBA scene rasterization
viewport: Preserves caller pixels per PostScript point; translates negative page origin, flips vertical axis, ceils output extent without anisotropic fit scaling
memory: Caller owns source bytes; managed program, VM, scene, render working data and output share caller root. Program and evaluation buffers drop before rasterization; only pixel credit remains on success
color: Caller explicitly chooses device Gray/RGB interpretation; CMYK conversion remains unsupported; transparent backdrop
verification: Authored valid EPS with negative BoundingBox produces all-red 4x4 and 8x8 rasters at densities 1 and 2; last-owner credit release; excessive dimensions rejected before root admission; insufficient memory and cancellation return no partial output
remaining: General PostScript operators/objects/streams, strict color and raster boundary gates, bounded file importer, viewer/cache/swap/GPU lifecycle and real-document throughput
status: Explicit subset API only; EPS common viewer route and catalog qualification remain pending
